answer: You don't need to pay off your loan first, and you don't need the title in hand to sell us a car you still owe money on. While the loan is open, your lender holds the title or electronic title record, and at the appointment we confirm what you owe and pay the lender off directly from your offer. If the offer is more than the payoff you get the difference, and if it's less you pay the difference at the appointment by cashier's check or debit card. Getting a payoff letter before you come in will speed things up.
